authority: Local filesystem ownership; actor roles are caller assertions, not external identity-provider authentication.

state.locking: OS advisory flock; coordinator writes only
state.audit: SHA256 hash chain and current-task digest; not a signed external attestation

ownership.stale_write_policy: reject expired lease and stale task version
ownership.expired_lease_recovery: explicit orchestrator recovery; never silently assume an editor stopped

reviews.evidence: kind plus SHA256 digest only; no provider credentials or raw production logs

execution.claim: Coordination and handover protocol, not permanent autonomous workers or OS-level editing confinement
